'''May 2000 Milwaukee tournament (20 May)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Milwaukee, WI on 20 May 2000. It is known from Ryan Fojtik's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d776">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-milwaukee-wi-5-20-00d776/ milwaukee-wi-5-20-00], DeckTech (Ryan "XjedeyeX" Fojtik, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-milwaukee-wi-5-20-00d776/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Milwaukee, WI
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
